summary: This Form 8-K is a routine periodic disclosure by Bain Capital Private Credit, a business development company (BDC). It reports an unregistered sale of 389,036 Class I shares to feeder vehicles at NAV, approximately $10.1 million, and declares a regular monthly distribution of $0.1875 per share. It also discloses updated NAV, portfolio composition, and shares outstanding. There is no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring. The items reported are standard operational updates for a BDC.
